intro.title: Scan a receipt
intro.body: Lay the receipt flat in good light. A long receipt can take several shots, top to bottom.

unreadable.title: Couldn't read this receipt
unreadable.body: Retake it flat and in good light, with its whole width in the frame.

failed.title: Couldn't scan the receipt
failed.body: Something went wrong while scanning. Try again.

saved.title: Receipt saved
saved.body: Only the receipt's text is kept, with card and loyalty numbers removed.
saved.bodyText: Your phone couldn't read this receipt on its own, so its text is sent to be read, without card and loyalty numbers.
saved.bodyDevice: Read on your phone, so nothing was sent. Card and loyalty numbers are removed from what's kept.
saved.readingPhotosSlow: Reading the photos can take up to a minute…
saved.offline: You're offline. The items will be picked out when you're back online.
saved.retryLaterTitle: Couldn't pick out the items yet
saved.retryLaterBody: The text is kept. The items will be picked out the next time you open this receipt.
saved.libraryPhoto: The photo you chose is still in your photo library.
saved.notReadBody: Only the text was kept. Scan the receipt again to try once more.
saved.tooLongTitle: This receipt is too long to read at once
saved.tooLongBody: Only the text was kept. Scan it in two parts to pick out the items.
saved.limitedBody: The text is kept. Open this receipt again after {{time}} to pick out its items.
saved.bodyPhoto: Your phone couldn't read this receipt on its own, so its photo was sent to be read as it is. The photo is deleted once read.
saved.bodyPhotoMasked: Your phone couldn't read this receipt on its own, so its photo was sent to be read, with card numbers, member numbers and names covered. The photo is deleted once read.
saved.photoNotReadBody: Nothing was kept. Scan the receipt again to try once more.
saved.photoLimitedBody: Nothing was kept. Scan the receipt again after {{time}}.
saved.failedBody: {{names}}. Open the review to see why, fix them and add them again.
saved.queuedBody: The items are in your pantry now and are recorded once the phone reconnects.

replace.title: Replace the saved receipt?
replace.body: Only one receipt is kept at a time.

photo.title: Take a photo instead
photo.body: This phone can't scan documents. Photograph the receipt flat and in good light, or choose a photo you've taken.

review.title: Receipt
review.dateScanned: Not printed on the receipt, so it's the day you scanned it.
review.intro: Check the product on each line. Only lines with a product are added to your pantry.
review.introTo: Check the product on each line. Only lines with a product are added to {{pantry}}.
review.choose: No match. Tap to choose the product.
review.failedLines_one: Couldn't add {{names}}. Open the saved receipt to try again.
review.failedLines_other: Couldn't add {{count}} lines ({{names}}). Open the saved receipt to try again.
review.failedLinesCount_one: Couldn't add {{count}} line. Open the saved receipt to try again.
review.failedLinesCount_other: Couldn't add {{count}} lines. Open the saved receipt to try again.
review.emptyBody: No item lines were read from this receipt. Scan it again, or add the items by hand.
review.needsUnit: Give it a unit to add it, like 2 L or 500 g.
review.totalNeeded: Enter what you paid for this line.
review.totalsTitle: The lines don't add up to the receipt
review.totalsBody: The items read add up to {{counted}}, but the receipt says {{printed}}. A line may have been missed, so check the list against the receipt before adding.
review.listIncompleteTitle: Your list is too long to check in full
review.listIncompleteBody: Only part of it was checked. A receipt line that matches an item further down is added on its own.
review.tickOffTitle: Tick it off the shopping list
review.tickOffBody: “{{name}}” is on your list. It's marked bought and moved to the pantry rather than added twice.
review.notStockedBody: Records what you paid without adding it to the pantry.
review.leftOut: Left out. Tap to add it.
review.notMatchedYet: Not matched yet. Tap to choose the product.
review.matchFailedBody: Tap to try again once you are online. You can also choose each product yourself.

photoSend.title: Send the photo to be read?
photoSend.body: This phone couldn't read the receipt's text. With your OK, the photo is sent to {{appName}} as it is, to be read and then deleted.
photoSend.offline: Connect to the internet to send the photo.

photoConsent.title: Send photos of receipts your phone can't read?
photoConsent.body: Photos are read more accurately than text. Card numbers your phone finds are covered first, and photos are deleted once read. You can change this in App Settings.
photoConsent.bodyUnmasked: Photos are read more accurately than text. The whole receipt is sent, and deleted once read. You can change this in App Settings.

photoSetting.title: Send photos of receipts your phone can't read
photoSetting.description: They're read more accurately from their photos, and deleted once read. Off, only the receipt's text is sent.
